records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, 8 days left, but no project, no invite, no milestone despite two nudges (email:2f68b932, email:eb1c5024). Customer replied positively yet vaguely -- "still getting used to the layout" (email:27df9972) signals low urgency rather than imminent setup. Active Pro plan and responsiveness give moderate unaided odds.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the update -- glad the first few days have gone smoothly, and it's good to know the layout is still settling in.

Since you're finding your way around, the most useful next step is getting a real project in: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through setting up your first project with you.

Best,
Priya
